description: UCI row 40 (age 30, LOW vulnerability, moderate knowledge, RT 6, horizon 3yr) — capital protected note: all hard rules pass, soft fails ['R3'] (score 85) -> SUITABLE
client_narrative: Tomáš Dvořák is 30 years old and works as a software developer at a technology startup. He earns approximately 109,800 euros per year and holds 36,000 euros in liquid savings. He wants to invest 3,000 euros for about 3 years. He has moderate investment knowledge: he understands bonds, equities, and basic structured products, and has invested in balanced funds and equity ETFs in the past. He rates his risk tolerance at 6 out of 10 and has confirmed he can afford to lose the full invested amount. His investment objective is capital preservation.
product_narrative: The product is a capital-protected structured note that guarantees 100% of the invested capital at maturity and provides participation in the upside of a eurozone equity index up to a defined cap. The note is issued by a regulated European bank, listed on a regulated market, and publishes a KID. It is classified as complex due to its structured payoff profile and the embedded equity-linked derivative. Moderate financial knowledge is required. The minimum recommended holding period is five years. In the event of issuer insolvency partial or total capital loss is possible, but under normal conditions the nominal capital is returned at maturity.
